items.title: Devissage with higher rank on an irreducible closed subset: for X Noetherian, Z_0 irreducible closed with generic point xi, a property P of coherent sheaves stable under extensions, descending from P(F^{oplus r}) to P(F), holding for pushforwards of ideal sheaves along integral closed subschemes properly inside Z_0, and for some coherent G supported on Z_0 with G_xi annihilated by m_xi such that every ideal J with J_xi = O_{X,xi} admits a subsheaf G' of JG with G'_xi = G_xi satisfying P: then P holds for every coherent sheaf whose support is contained in Z_0.

items.difficulty_reason: The induction is fully written in the span: filtrations reduce sheaves with support strictly inside Z_0 to the subquotient case (devissage lemma-coherent-filter plus assumption (3)); given G as in (4), lemma-prepare-filter-irreducible produces 0 -> i_*I^{oplus r} -> G -> Q -> 0 with support of Q strictly smaller, and the same for any nonzero ideal I' contained in I; cutting out supp Q' by an ideal J and applying power-ideal-kills-sheaf gives J^n Q' = 0, hence J^n G lands inside i_*(I')^{oplus r}; assumption (4)(c) then supplies G' subset J^n G with G'_xi = G_xi satisfying P, so 0 -> G' -> i_*(I')^{oplus r} -> Q'' -> 0 and extension stability give P for i_*(I')^{oplus r}, descent along direct sums gives P for i_*I', and intersecting an arbitrary ideal I'' with I gives P for i_*I'' via a further short exact sequence with smaller support; a final application of the filtration lemma covers every coherent sheaf supported on Z_0.
